# salucallc/ci-shared

> Reusable GitHub Actions workflows (workflow_call) for salucallc and saluca-labs repos: Python and Node stack CI, Docker lint/build/scan, SAST, secret scanning, release on tag, a README/llms.txt docs check, and the estate merge gate (merge-gate.yml plus the gate/ checks it runs). MIT licence.

This repo holds workflows, small stdlib Python helpers, and the merge gate (gate/, stdlib only, runnable before a push with `python tools/gate.py run --repo <dir>`); it is not a library or an action. Consumers call a workflow by full commit SHA, never by tag or branch. Every third-party action inside is pinned to a commit SHA.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/README.md): every workflow, its inputs, the caller snippets, pinning policy
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to change this repo and what must pass

## Code

- [reusable-python-ci.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-python-ci.yml): install, compileall, pytest when tests exist
- [reusable-node-ci.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-node-ci.yml): install, typecheck, build, test
- [reusable-secret-scan.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-secret-scan.yml): TruffleHog verified-only scan
- [repo-docs.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/repo-docs.yml): README headings, llms.txt shape, em-dash check, gitleaks over full history
- [merge-gate.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/merge-gate.yml): the merge gate, one job per check, fan-in `Merge gate all`
- [gate/cli.py](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/gate/cli.py): the gate's runner; checks in gate/checks/, tests in gate/tests/
- [tools/gate.py](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/tools/gate.py): run the gate against any repo before a push
- [tools/branch_protection.py](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/tools/branch_protection.py): dry-run proposal of branch protection for the gate
- [self-validate.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/self-validate.yml): actionlint and yamllint over this repo
- [self-test.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/self-test.yml): runs the stack workflows on fixtures/ and repo-docs.yml on this repo
- [tools/write_caller.py](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/tools/write_caller.py): writes a consumer ci.yml pinned to a SHA

## Optional

- [reusable-semgrep.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-semgrep.yml): Semgrep rulepacks
- [reusable-sast-python.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-sast-python.yml): Bandit
- [reusable-dep-scan-python.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-dep-scan-python.yml): pip-audit and safety
- [reusable-lint-dockerfile.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-lint-dockerfile.yml): Hadolint
- [reusable-build-smoke-docker.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-build-smoke-docker.yml): Buildx smoke build
- [reusable-image-cve-scan.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-image-cve-scan.yml): rebuild and Trivy scan
- [reusable-release-on-tag.yml](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-release-on-tag.yml): release on v* tag
- [tools/ci_inventory.py](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/tools/ci_inventory.py): read-only CI inventory of both orgs through gh
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/llms-full.txt): this header plus the full README
- [CLAIMS.md](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/CLAIMS.md): what the README says the gate does, mapped to code and tests
- [examples/](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/tree/main/examples): caller workflow, pre-commit config, CLAIMS.md and PR templates
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
